She's at forty kilometers and closing, no transponder, her drive running hot. A raider, small and fast, built to come alongside. The captain has said battle stations. The deck is quiet except for the air handler and somebody's boots.

She is a good deal faster than you, and turns better. She has the guns on you. You can take a good deal more than she can. Position: even. Armor 260/260.

scenes.title: The Lock
scenes.text:
The outer lock is cycling from the outside. The inner door has a thin bright seam in it where a cutter is working. Everyone who can be here's here, behind the closer, and the captain's voice on the intercom says to hold it.

Boarders: 3. With you: 5. Your ship is long, with room to go round and little room for a rush.

scenes.text:

scenes.title: The Corridor
